title: Greetings & introductions
practiceFocus: Say your name, where you are from, and what you do

points.title: Two ways to say who you are
points.rule: Soy means “I am” for origin and job. Me llamo means “my name is”. A question starts with the question word; the rest stays in the same order.

grammar.notYet: The full ser table, gender, and vosotros. Later days add them when a phrase needs them.

phrases.english: I work as a software engineer.
I am well, thank you. And you?

practice.title: Introduce yourself
practice.instruction: Say your name, where you are from, and what you do. Keep going even if you stumble.
tips: Speak out loud. Do not stop to translate every word.
Repeat the whole introduction three times.
